notes: All six records Argued; the scenes keep each page's own proof boundary — dia/syn productive vs severing, chronic's temporal cross, translations' three claim standings.

Rework 2026-10-07 (craft lane 4): word-labels replaced by the records' own operations drawn — the pole axis with its three exact operator results, the refit token with the seam line kept visible, the x/2 landscape against one highlighted trajectory, the two chains of the one subject, the office lanes with the double ?/!, and the translation map with its boundary plate.

Colour: three pair-grounds — umber for the cut and its gathering, slate for configuration and the one field, olive-sage for plurality and its translations. Tints travel copper→steel→sage, gold at the seams earned.
Stillness: each ground holds across its pair (3 of 5 adjacent pairs still); motion only at the pair changes.
Stage text 40 words across six scenes.

Deepen 2026-10-07 (lane 4): four scenes stand in 3d, in still pairs deepened identically so the rests survive. Dia and syn — the third dimension is the interior the cut falls into: the slash travels at z +0.25 before the axis that both poles need (z −0.3); the broken token rides toward the viewer (z +0.3) while the gathered field holds it from behind (z −0.25). Their shared morph clock is pulse-driven (θ̇ 0.2, dwell 0.5): for dia the pulse is the cut falling; for syn the same beat is the seam refitting.

Deepen, chronic and mono — the third dimension is the passage: the landscape stands behind (z −0.4) while the fixed point travels in front (z +0.2); the one field recedes (z −0.35) behind the chains of notation (z +0.25) — the one is deeper than any of its notations. Their shared clock turns slowly (law theta, θ̇ 0.1, φ̇ 0.06, smooth drive): the field holds while the passage turns. Poly and translations stay planar — address lanes and correspondence are drawn flat, on purpose.

Deepen, physics states: three profiles — warm cut (grain 0.04, halo 0.16, softness 0.24) for dia-syn, cool passage (grain 0.032, roundness 0.96) for chronic-mono, olive lanes (elongation 0.06) for poly-translations. Props vary across the pairs, hold within them.

Deepen, titles: every scene carries the record's own line — dia #0 'Begin inside the field', syn #0 'Gather terms that remain distinct', chronic record title kept, mono #5→0 near-quote 'The one through the many', poly #0 'Inventory offices rather than synonyms', translations record title 'Correspondence with its proof boundary'. Stage words 56.
